scope: Secondary descriptive checks, defined before inspection of EVAL_N or challenge score results. No model, calibration or cohort changes.
axes: same-source JPEG75 and fixed twelve-parent compound panel

matching.algorithm: One-to-one minimum-cost assignment of twenty synthetics to twenty photo controls, without using candidate scores
matching.meaning: Descriptor matching only, not same-scene causal evidence. Report distances and all pairs, do not discard inconvenient matches.

strata.missingCells: Explicit lack of mixed-class support, not zero effect

pairedUncertainty: 2000 seeded paired-parent resamples for original decision-rate differences A1-A0,A2-A0,B0-A0,B1-B0; separately positive and negative. Nominal intervals do not account for few generator/device clusters.
